title: "Draft & Tank, Vertical Slice"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libs}

library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(here)
```

```{r load}

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), dbname = "nhl", host = "localhost")

games <- read_csv(here("data", "games_raw.csv"))

dbExecute(con, "TRUNCATE games")
dbWriteTable(con, "games", games, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)

dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS n FROM games GROUP BY season ORDER BY season")
```

```{r pull}

team_games <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    tg.team,
    tg.season,
    s.season_label,
    tg.game_date,
    tg.points,
    CASE
      WHEN tg.game_date <= s.trade_deadline THEN 'pre'
      ELSE 'post'
    END AS window
  FROM team_games tg
  JOIN season_structure s ON s.season = tg.season
")

nrow(team_games)    # 7872
head(team_games)
```

```{r summary}

team_summary <- team_games |>
  group_by(team, season, season_label, window) |>
  summarise(
    points_pct = sum(points) / (2 * n()),
    games      = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

head(team_summary)
```

```{r wide}

wide <- team_summary |>
  select(team, season, season_label, window, points_pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = points_pct) |>
  mutate(drop = post - pre)


head(wide)
nrow(wide)
```

```{r plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

ggplot(wide, aes(x = pre, y = drop)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ season_label) +
  labs(
    x = "Pre-deadline points %",
    y = "Drop = post − pre points %",
    title    = "Does late-season performance drop more for bad teams?",
    subtitle = "One dot per team-season. Positive slope = bad teams drop more (tank signal)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r fit}

fit <- lm(drop ~ pre, data = wide)
summary(fit)
```

**NEW SECTION: Diagnostics**

```{r per-season-fits}

library(broom)

per_season <- wide |>
  group_by(season_label) |>
  group_modify(~ tidy(lm(drop ~ pre, data = .x))) |>
  filter(term == "pre") |>
  select(season_label, estimate, std.error, p.value)

per_season
```

```{r playoff-split}

# Pull total points per team-season from the database
totals <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT team, season, SUM(points) AS total_pts
  FROM team_games
  GROUP BY team, season
")

# Rank within season, flag top 16 as 'made playoffs'
playoff_lookup <- totals |>
  group_by(season) |>
  mutate(made_playoffs = rank(-total_pts) <= 16) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(team, season, made_playoffs)

# Merge into the wide table
wide2 <- wide |>
  left_join(playoff_lookup, by = c("team", "season"))

# Plot colored by playoff status
ggplot(wide2, aes(x = pre, y = drop, color = made_playoffs)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ season_label) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#1b9e77", `FALSE` = "#d95f02"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "Made playoffs", `FALSE` = "Missed")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Pre-deadline points %",
    y = "Drop = post − pre points %",
    title = "Same data, split by playoff outcome",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r playoff-split-fits}

wide2 |>
  group_by(made_playoffs) |>
  group_modify(~ tidy(lm(drop ~ pre, data = .x))) |>
  filter(term == "pre")
```

*The above is very telling \^*

```{r extremes}

# 10 biggest drops — late-season crashers
wide2 |>
  arrange(drop) |>
  head(10) |>
  select(team, season_label, pre, post, drop, made_playoffs)

# 10 biggest gains — late-season risers
wide2 |>
  arrange(desc(drop)) |>
  head(10) |>
  select(team, season_label, pre, post, drop, made_playoffs)
```

**Final Examination of Tank Incentives**

```{r pull_elim}

elim_games <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    tg.team,
    tg.season,
    s.season_label,
    tg.game_date,
    tg.points,
    te.elimination_date,
    te.seed,
    te.final_points
  FROM team_games tg
  JOIN team_elimination te
    ON te.team = tg.team AND te.season = tg.season
  JOIN season_structure s
    ON s.season = tg.season
  WHERE te.missed_playoffs
")

nrow(elim_games)   # expect 48 teams × 82 games = 3936
```

```{r summary_elim}

elim_summary <- elim_games |>
  mutate(window = if_else(game_date <= elimination_date, "pre", "post")) |>
  group_by(team, season, season_label, seed, final_points, window) |>
  summarise(
    points_pct = sum(points) / (2 * n()),
    games      = n(),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

head(elim_summary)
```

```{r wide_elim}

library(tidyr)

elim_wide <- elim_summary |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = window,
    values_from = c(points_pct, games)
  ) |>
  mutate(drop = points_pct_post - points_pct_pre)

elim_wide |> arrange(games_post) |> head(10)
```

```{r diag_windows}

elim_wide |>
  summarise(
    n_teams         = n(),
    teams_no_post   = sum(is.na(games_post)),
    median_post     = median(games_post, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_post        = min(games_post,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_post        = max(games_post,    na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pre      = median(games_pre)
  )

```

```{r plot_elim, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}

ggplot(elim_wide, aes(x = points_pct_pre, y = drop)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(aes(size = games_post), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ season_label) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), name = "Post-elim\ngames") +
  labs(
    title    = "Pre vs post mathematical elimination — non-playoff teams only",
    subtitle = "Positive slope = worse teams drop more after elimination (tank signal). Dot size = post-elim reliability.",
    x        = "Pre-elimination points %",
    y        = "Drop = post − pre points %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r fit_elim}

fit_elim <- lm(drop ~ points_pct_pre, data = elim_wide)
summary(fit_elim)

fit_elim_w <- lm(drop ~ points_pct_pre, data = elim_wide,
                 weights = games_post)
summary(fit_elim_w)
```
